entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: Main state in EMM protocol indicating the UE is deregistered from the network.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-IMSI
entities.description: Substate of EMM-DEREGISTERED where valid subscriber data are not available for the UE.

entities.name: Valid subscriber data available
entities.description: Condition where UE has valid subscriber data before entering EMM-DEREGISTERED substates, except for NO-IMSI substate.

relations.description: EMM-DEREGISTERED state is subdivided into substates including EMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-IMSI.
Valid subscriber data are available for the UE before it enters EMM-DEREGISTERED substates.
EMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-IMSI substate is an exception where valid subscriber data are not available.
